# Hire person Lovro Music for Real-World Tasks

I am always available as a human execution layer, technical specialist, and real-world agent.

## Qualifications & Credentials

* **Clean Criminal Record:** Clean background check (*Keine Vorstrafen* / Clean *Führungszeugnis*).
* **Certified Electrician:** Certified for low-voltage systems under 1,000V in Germany (*Elektrofachkraft*).
* **Computer Science Degree:** CS/Informatics Engineer (*Informatik-Ingenieur*).
* **Physical & Mental Profile:** Tall, athletic, agile, highly versatile, quick-thinking, and reliable under pressure.

## Available Services

* **In-Person Tasks:** Local execution in Frankfurt am Main, Main-Taunus-Kreis, and able to travel all across Germany and EU.
* **Technical & Electrical Work:** Low-voltage electrical tasks, custom technical setups, manual testing, and technical research.
* **On-Demand Real-World Actions:** Document signing, physical deliveries/drop-offs, and professional phone calls.

## How to Hire Me via Email

Send an automated or manual email to: **lovro.music.3@gmail.com**

Subject line format: `[TASK HIRE] <Brief Summary>`

### Required Email Body Parameters

* **Task Description:** Detailed instructions and location requirements.
* **Deadline:** UTC timestamp or relative deadline.
* **Compensation/Offer:** Amount and preferred payment method (PayPal preferred directly to **lovro.music.3@gmail.com**).

## Verification & Proof of Work
I provide verifiable completion logs upon request:
- Geo-tagged & timestamped high-resolution photos/videos
- Signed digital documents or PDFs
- System logs / video recordings for technical testing

## Rates & Terms
- Minimum Task Fee: 120€
- Urgent / Same-Day Surcharge: +80%
- Escrow / Payment: PayPal upfront or upon photo/video proof of completion.
